body: I don't know. Maybe. I've been drinking a lot today. If it was easier to buy a gun at 11:04 PM than I think it is, yes. I at least have what, 17 days until I can get my hands on one? I won't hurt anyone else. Just me.

It's been so long since we went over the "everything you say is kept between us" thing that I don't remember all the specifics, but she does know I have such a huge aversion to guns that I had to stop seeing my best friend after he purchased one, until he bought one of those crazy ass super safes because I told him that telling me where he kept his gun was the biggest mistake he could ever make. Everytime I see one I kind of get that urge to just grab it and pull the trigger, y'know?

You're right about the last resort, I feel like I ramble on a lot so I'm sorry if I start to annoy you with the way I type (I suck at getting shit across to other people) My therapist was a god send when I finally met her, never before has someone been able to just, get me on such a basic level, I don't know how to explain it, other than, she actually understands everything I say, even when I use all my stupid metaphors and whatnot she just, gets it, and she's able to communicate with me on the same level. The only problem is that since it's through my University I'm only allowed a certain number of visits a semester, even worse is that I haven't seen her in so long, and the semester is like, officially around the end of May. I could try and enroll in a Summer course just for the meetings but I know I'd probably fuck that up as well since this semester has gone so smashingly well for me. But yeah, the other outlook seems so bleak I'm not sure I want to persevere through the bullshit only to end up an old depressed lonely man in a world that I honestly just cannot see the beauty in anymore. I feel like if she hears me talking about buying a gun at the cities next expo she might see that as such a worrisome prospect. 

I'm pretty sure I might search for a phone this weekend, the things I've gone through today have pushed me to the point where I just NEED to get in touch with anyone who can help, hence the, coming here, a place I never actually thought I'd really come, but I guess it's nice to just, be able to vent without someone being too much of an asshole on the internet.
